lines: Seventy-one percent of lifters on steroids had weak hearts.
A healthy heart pumps out over half its blood each beat.
Under fifty-two percent counts as weak.
One study scanned a hundred forty lifters.
Of those on steroids... seventy-one percent pumped too weakly.
Lifters who never used? Only two.
Longer use also meant more plaque in the arteries.
Save this before your next gym debate.
